status: proposed integration contract for tested reference modules; not installed in live game
artifactInvariant: artifact == 1 exactly when step is 2 or 3; otherwise 0
trustedArrival: actual server-controlled squad arrival is verified by adapter
trustedBattle: species and level match campaign configuration
trustedMechanism: server checks actual landmark or simultaneous plate occupancy
trustedEscort: exact three distinct captive IDs for site
escrowInvariant: for each resource: earned == claimed + pending; earned equals sum of uniquely completed task awards plus prologue and final when eligible
commitAtomicity: real project wallet modification when claiming
requestReplay: same owner and request key with same body returns current authoritative state and no repeated effects; changed body rejects
concurrency: integrate within existing CoreGameServer transaction and hosted CAS, no separate non-atomic write
timestamps: optional server audit metadata stored outside strict campaign state
migration: initialize only missing namespace; reject unsupported or corrupt state without overwriting bytes; never trust legacy client imports for rewards
fogPersistence: keep persistent explored state and current visibility separate; use code/fog.mjs contract and data/world-atlas.json; camera and client mask cannot award discovery
pause: only adventure command availability/UI; existing world travel, combat and queues continue
ordinaryCombatRewards: retain genuine first combat rewards separately from guaranteed campaign totals; no campaign guardian respawn farming; idempotent each source
accessAuthority: selected authenticated server player p.city completed hall level; not local timer, queued upgrade or client JSON
introRules: no rewards for viewing, finishing or skipping
intro acknowledgment never blocks unlocked campaign
autoplay only once on safe city foreground; after interruption offer Continue
publish present_intro only after successful state+receipt CAS
UI readiness is presentation input, never access or reward authority
explicit migration of missing intro namespace with validated existing campaign phase != prologue marks existing_progress
acknowledged replay is local presentation only at hall >=3; no server mutation or rewards
lockedPolicy: All adventure mutations, mechanisms, route entry, fog reveal and campaign claims require hall>=3. Hide quest POIs and horse. Preserve existing bytes and reserve. Auto-refill below3 transfers zero and does not undo unrelated spending.
bossAndHighGuardianGate: Keep original level3 guardians and both begin_boss/finish_boss at hall>=5
